metaShifts.description: Continuing the trend from 7.38c, this patch systematically nerfs overperforming neutral items: Dezun Bloodrite no longer affects attack-based abilities (major nerf to OD/Viper), Giant's Maul duration reduced, Magnifying Monocle range decreased, and Helm of Undying cooldown doubled. Only Crude receives meaningful buffs. This further flattens the neutral item power spike and reduces game-deciding RNG.

Building on 7.38c's spell-based nerfs, this patch targets remaining overperformers: Shadow Shaman damage/cooldown nerfs, Templar Assassin Refraction gutted (mana +10, damage severely reduced), Nature's Prophet ultimate damage decreased, and Dark Seer Ion Shell duration reduced. This reinforces the physical damage renaissance by removing spell-dominant lane controllers.

Following 7.38c's mobility standardization, this patch makes surgical adjustments: Night Stalker Void duration scaling nerfed early game, Centaur max speed reduced, Elder Titan base speed decreased, and terrain changes affecting juke paths. These changes demand more precise positioning without major mechanical overhauls.

After 7.38c's healing meta reinforcement, this patch fine-tunes support power levels: Omniknight Hammer of Purity severely nerfed (cooldown and damage), Oracle slightly weakened, but Lich Death Charge buffed and Skywrath Mage Arcane Bolt improved. This prevents any single support archetype from dominating while maintaining healing meta viability.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Burrowstrike mana cost reduction (110→100 at level 1) combined with +200 cast range talent buff creates more reliable initiation windows. Lower mana costs allow for more frequent rotations, while extended range improves Blink→Burrowstrike→Epicenter combos.

Falcon Rush now works with unit-targeted attacks, enabling synergy with items like Diffusal Blade, Desolator, and Skadi. Combined with Talon Toss mana reduction and Shodo Sai parry buffs, Kez becomes significantly more viable as a right-click core in the physical damage meta.

Base armor +1 buff combined with the ongoing physical damage renaissance (Desolator buffs from 7.38c) makes Sniper more survivable in right-click focused games. The spell-heavy hero nerfs (Shadow Shaman, TA, NP) remove his primary counters.

Death Charge mana restoration increased from 15% to 25% creates powerful synergy with mana-hungry supports like Crystal Maiden, Invoker, or Skywrath Mage. In teamfight-heavy metas, this provides significant sustain for spell-casting allies.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Dezun Bloodrite no longer affects attack-based abilities, completely removing the synergy with Arcane Orb. This was a core power spike for OD in mid-game teamfights, significantly reducing his neutral item scaling potential.

Similar to OD, Poison Attack no longer benefits from Dezun Bloodrite's spell amplification. This removes a significant mid-game power spike for Viper, who relied on this interaction for enhanced teamfight presence.

Refraction mana cost increase (85→95) and damage reduction (20/40/60/80→15/30/45/60) severely impacts her laning efficiency. Items like Bottle and early stat items become less effective when her core ability is significantly weaker.

Ether Shock damage nerfs and Shackles cooldown increases reduce the effectiveness of cast range extensions. The hero's reduced burst potential makes positioning items less impactful when the base abilities are weaker.

Carry.explanation: Base armor +1 improves survivability in the physical damage meta. Spell-heavy counter heroes (TA, Shadow Shaman, Nature's Prophet) all received significant nerfs, creating a more favorable environment for his positioning-based playstyle.

Mid.explanation: Falcon Rush improvements (duration buff, unit-targeted attack compatibility) and Talon Toss mana reduction significantly improve his mid-game impact. Shodo Sai parry buffs enhance his teamfight contribution, making him more viable as a tempo-controlling mid.

Arcane Bolt base damage increase (60/85/110/135→60/90/120/150) improves his laning phase and early game impact. With spell-heavy competitors nerfed, he becomes a stronger mid option for magical burst strategies.

Offlane.explanation: Burrowstrike mana cost reduction and talent buffs (+200 cast range, +25 Sand Storm damage) significantly improve his initiation reliability and farming efficiency. Lower mana costs enable more frequent rotations and better lane presence.

SoftSupport.explanation: Sticky Bomb damage increase (80/160/240/320→95/170/245/320) improves his zoning and teamfight contribution. In a meta moving away from spell-heavy cores, his area denial becomes more valuable for controlling objectives.

Fiend's Gate mana cost reduction (200→175) improves his utility as a position 4. Better mana efficiency allows for more frequent rotations and map control, valuable in the current positioning-focused meta.

HardSupport.explanation: Death Charge mana restoration buff (15%→25%) significantly improves his teamfight sustain utility. This makes him more valuable in extended engagements and provides better support for mana-intensive allies.

Carry.explanation: Dark Unity damage penalty increase (50%→60%) reduces his illusion-based farming and fighting efficiency. This directly impacts his core identity as an illusion carry, making him less effective in both farming patterns and teamfights.

Barracuda health gain reduction at level 1 (10→5) significantly weakens his early game survivability. This impacts his ability to trade efficiently in lane and reduces his snowball potential in the early-mid game transition.

Mid.explanation: Refraction nerfs are devastating: mana cost increase (85→95) and damage reduction (20/40/60/80→15/30/45/60) severely impact her laning dominance and farming efficiency. Her core mid-game power spike is significantly diminished.
Dezun Bloodrite no longer affecting Arcane Orb removes a crucial neutral item synergy. This reduces his mid-game teamfight scaling and makes him less reliable as a magical damage core.

Offlane.explanation: Ion Shell duration reduction (21/24/27/30s→20/22/24/26s) and Wall of Replica cast range nerf (1300→1000) significantly impact his farming efficiency and teamfight initiation. His core offlane identity as a farming initiator is weakened.

Wrath of Nature base damage reduction (100/140/180→90/130/170) reduces his global impact and teamfight contribution. This weakens his ability to influence multiple lanes and secure kills across the map.

Rugged no longer increasing block chance against towers removes his tower-diving and high-ground defense capabilities. This reduces his effectiveness in both aggressive plays and defensive situations.

SoftSupport.explanation: Ether Shock damage nerfs (140/200/260/320→125/190/255/320) and Shackles cooldown increase (13/12/11/10s→14/13/12/11s) significantly reduce his laning presence and teamfight burst. His core utility as a disable-heavy support is diminished.

Void duration scaling nerf (2/2.5/3/3.5/4s→1.6/2.2/2.8/3.4/4s) particularly impacts early-mid game, reducing his ganking effectiveness during his power spike timings. This weakens his roaming support viability.

HardSupport.explanation: Hammer of Purity receives massive nerfs: cooldown increase (16/12/8/4s→20/15/10/5s) and damage reduction (40/60/80/100→25/50/75/100). This severely impacts his laning presence and early game trading ability as a position 5.

Strength gain reduction (2.4→2.2) and Rain of Destiny heal amplification decrease (20%→15%) reduce both his survivability and healing utility. This makes him less effective in the current healing-focused support meta.
